# opnsense_dhcrelay_relay (Data Source)

DHCP relays (**Services ▸ DHCP Relay ▸ Relays**), one per interface.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the DHCP relay.

### Read-Only

- `agent_info` (Boolean) Append the relay agent information option (82).
- `carp_depend_on` (String) CARP VIP the relay follows; it only runs while that VIP is master.
- `destination` (String) ID of the `opnsense_dhcrelay_destination` to relay to.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the relay is enabled.
- `interface` (String) Interface DHCP requests are relayed from.
